question.text: Per SEBI (AIF) Regulations, NAV for a close-ended Category III AIF must be disclosed to investors at which frequency?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.1, close-ended Cat III AIFs disclose NAV at quarterly intervals to investors. The Trap: Open-ended Cat III AIFs disclose monthly; daily is used if investing in listed securities only for internal pricing. Cross-Exam Context: Consistent with Ch 5.16.6 (Valuation). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Log the NAV disclosure calendar and synchronize with investor statements.
